scope: Selection of existing scored rows only; no text alteration, resplitting, or rescoring.

rules.code_markup: Reject code fences, isolated backtick-wrapped rows, and retained code/pre/kbd HTML tags.
rules.table_markup: Reject pipe rows with at least three pipes or a markdown separator.
rules.url: Reject rows containing an http, https, ftp, www, or mailto URL token.
rules.command_path_dominated: Reject prompt-led commands or rows dominated by a fixed command starter plus shell flag, assignment, operator, or path syntax.
rules.heading_fragment: Reject rows beginning with one to six Markdown heading markers.
rules.list_fragment: Reject marked bullet or numbered-list rows only when terminal sentence punctuation is absent.
rules.very_short_fragment: Reject rows with fewer than five whitespace-delimited tokens.
rules.low_alphabetic_content: Reject rows whose alphabetic-character share among non-space characters is below 0.60.
